source.title: Enhanced nuclear fusion in the sub-keV energy regime
source.reported_observation: Relative D-D fusion yield plateau below approximately 2 keV center-of-mass energy in Pd/PdD and Ti/TiD targets; constant homogeneous screening-potential model does not describe the full curve.
source.critical_boundary: The quoted enhancement approaching or exceeding 1e18 is relative to an unscreened bare-nucleus yield model. It is not net energy gain, useful electric output, a commercial fusion result, or a UQPU replication.

candidate_model.incumbent_assumption: A spatially homogeneous target with a constant effective screening potential adequately describes the measured energy-dependent yield.
candidate_model.alternative_hypothesis: Depth-weighted heterogeneous reaction environments with independently measured deuterium occupancy and defect state may contribute to the low-energy plateau.
required_checks: dimensional consistency and consistent energy frames
D-D reaction-channel, charge, baryon-number and energy conservation
causal ordering of loading, irradiation, defect evolution and yield

project_effect: Add a source-bounded mechanism question to FUS-001/FND-005; do not change any fusion electricity, biomass material, bio-oil, finance or UQPU performance estimate.
next_gate: Preregister blinded independent replication with calibrated beam energy/current, matched detector and background controls, absolute yield per delivered charge, depth-resolved deuterium and defect measurements, matched-complexity incumbent/alternative models, held-out low-energy points and an independent lab.

lanes.A: No computing workload, compiler/runtime or quantum-advantage result.
lanes.B: No provider integration or QPU job.
lanes.C: No memory, state-storage or data-movement result.
lanes.D: Potential metrology lead for target surface, defect and material-state measurements; no device advantage.
lanes.E: Reaction-physics literature lead only; no useful power or accepted fuel is demonstrated.
lanes.F: No net MWh, lifecycle-cost, financing or uncertainty-bounded commercial model.
lanes.G: No manufacturing yield, target lifetime or scale-up evidence.
lanes.H: Dated literature watch and cross-lane integration record published.

evidence_boundary: No new physical law, quantum advantage, biomass-carbon substitution, accepted bio-oil, commercial fusion electricity, interest-rate reduction or Data-Center-to-Phone result is claimed.
